name: you
text: Excuse me, I need to submit my enrolment form. Is this the right counter?

name: Receptionist
text: It is. Take a token and wait like everyone else. Have you seen that queue?

name: you
text: That's... a lot of people. Is there any way to move faster?

name: Receptionist
text: Maybe. I call the tokens in a pattern. Tell me which tokens come next, in order, and I'll move you up. One wrong guess and the queue reshuffles.

name: you
text: Guess the next numbers... Alright, let me look at the board.
